digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center reconciler)
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) lack symmetric test coverage for shared behaviors; DC lacks Cloud's byte-for-byte characterization pins and field-length convergence tests, while Cloud lacks DC's pagination proofs and rate-limiting matrix
DC adapter's field values, sanitizer boundaries, and probe branches are untested by value; contract tests assert only shape, leaving actual values unverified
The ticket-type map between local and Jira systems is duplicated across adapters and lacks a build-time guard to prevent divergence
Vacuous tests exist that do not assert the contracts their docstrings claim, creating false confidence in coverage
Cloud's pagination has never been tested past a single page, creating a latent truncation risk in whole-project readers
Oversized field convergence in DC requires multi-pass pinning with provenance documentation linking to Jira configuration constants and related bugs
